comments.author: Shoddy_Peanut7320
comments.body: Clear diagram, and the note that a forecast, a signal and a profitable trade are four different things is the right way to see it. With five neural nets plus other models voting, I'd check that the training and test data are split by time, so the models never see future data. Win probability only helps if it's calibrated, meaning trades it calls 60% win about 60% of the time. The dashboard shows paper results with costs counted, which is good, so the next step is a longer stretch with no changes to the rules. Cymetica lets you connect your own AI agent and run it in paper mode first, which is a similar way to test one.
